def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cp_async_alignment_deficit) * w[0]
    s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_ratio * w[5]
    s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[6]
    s = s + f.tm_regstaged * f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[7]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * w[2]
    else:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[3]
        s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_idle * w[4]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 1.0e-4:
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[1]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[8]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[9]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[10]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[11]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + np.log2(f.padded_gemm_work_ratio) * w[0]
    s = s + f.launch_wave_tail_fraction * w[1]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[2]
    s = s + f.tm_log_inst * w[3]
    s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[6]
    s = s + f.tm_regstaged * np.log2(f.k_step_granularity_time_ratio) * w[7]
    s = s + (1.0 - f.tm_regstaged) * f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[8]
    s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[9]
    s = s + np.log2(f.tm_crit_ratio) * w[10]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        pass
    else:
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure_ratio * w[4]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure_ratio * w[5]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[0]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[1]
    else:
        pass
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[2]
    s = s + (f.k_iteration_padding_ratio - 1.0) * w[3]
    if p.cp_async_alignment_deficit > 0:
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[4]
    else:
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[5]
    s = s + f.cta_epilogue_traffic_ratio * w[6]
    s = s + (f.instruction_density * 1000.0) * w[7]
    s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[8]
    s = s + f.smem_capacity_pressure * w[9]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + np.log2(np.fmax(f.output_tile_padding_ratio, 1.0)) * w[0]
    s = s + f.cta_wave_underfill_ratio * w[1]
    s = s + f.cp_async_alignment_deficit * w[2]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[3]
    s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[4]
    s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[5]
    if p.working_set_l2_ratio <= 1.0:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[6]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + 0.5 * (f.dram_w1_hz_ratio + f.dram_w1_id_ratio)) * w[7]
    else:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[8]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + 0.5 * (f.dram_w1_hz_ratio + f.dram_w1_id_ratio)) * w[9]
    return s
